references.text: Concerns compensation and restitution of what has been wrongfully taken, linking the guilt offering to restoration
Legislation regarding theft and return of stolen goods, including conditions for compensation
Deals with entrusted property (פִּקָּדוֹן) that is stolen or lost, and the responsibility to return it
The duty to return what has been found (אֲבֵדָה) to its rightful owner
Ezekiel speaks of how the wicked must restore what they have robbed (גְּזֵלָה) in order to live
Zacchaeus' promise to repay fourfold what he had extorted from people illustrates the principle of restitution and compensation
Prohibition against oppressing (עָשַׁק) one's neighbor or robbing them
